pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit irregular, stellate geometry with sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the upper neck are larger and more block-like, while those on the mid-flank are smaller with multiple acute angular projections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored corridors form a continuous, reticulated network with a high density of triradiate junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is narrow and relatively uniform, providing high topological connectivity between dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile consisting of short, densely packed hair filaments.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, vertically oriented, light-colored linear mark is visible on the posterior rump near the tail base, indicating a localized de-pigmentation and textural disruption consistent with an acquired scar.
